description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing E1AP protocol procedures in a 3GPP telecommunications context, including connection management, control message handling, statistics, and notifications related to CU-UP (CU User Plane) operations.

classes.name: e1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E1AP connection procedures, including establishing and releasing connections.

classes.name: e1ap_control_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling E1AP control messages such as bearer context release, inactivity notifications, and data notifications.

classes.name: e1ap_statistics_handler
classes.description: Interface for querying statistics related to E1AP, such as number of registered UEs.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of received messages like bearer context setup, modification, release, and E1 reset.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_connection_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of connection loss events.

classes.name: e1ap_interface
classes.description: Combined interface aggregating message handling, control, event, connection management, and statistics.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_notifier
classes.description: Combined notifier for CU-UP manager, handling message notifications and connection loss events.
